model.bootstrap: stratified two wells per level with replacement plus shared-control event draws; n2 limitation

model.fitting_method: bounded least squares with equal weight per independent well; 20 wells, 10 levels

internal_screen.measurement_uncertainty: per-sample RAS margin added afterwards; may narrow eligibility

model.inverse_policy: unique piecewise-linear inverse; plateau=>identified interval; outside=>null, never clip/extrapolate

output_policy.research: emit compatible numeric point with conditional interval and compatibility set
output_policy.routine: no qualified result for this release

known_limits: retrospective label correction not independently verified

population_modes.blue_positive_reporter: reporter & raw_BFP > BFP_positivity_threshold; linked editor required

qc_rules.state: WARN unless acquisition or score fails
qc_rules.saturation: counts at/above PnR and at observed maximum; metadata range exceedance does not establish physical clipping
qc_rules.missing_BFP: reporter remains possible in a separately qualified context; coexpression unavailable

uncertainty.shared_controls: one GR noise draw per bootstrap ID used jointly across wells
uncertainty.between_wells: n=2 independent transfection wells per condition; not event CI

limitations: not transferable solely on instrument match
